versions.content: Mapping of bitfields between NvBlockDescriptor and PortPrototype It is possible to map a bitfield contained in the DataPrototype representing the ramBlock to a bitfield contained in a DataPrototype defined in the context of a PortPrototype on the surface of the enclosing NvBlockSwCom- ponentType by means of the definition of attributes NvBlockDataMapping . bit- fieldTextTableMaskNvBlockDescriptor and NvBlockDataMapping . bit- fieldTextTableMaskPortPrototype . In this case [constr_2013] is not applicable.

Mapping of bitfields between NvBlockDescriptor and PortPrototype It is possible to map a bitfield contained in the DataPrototype representing the ramBlock to a bitfield contained in a DataPrototype defined in the context of a PortPrototype on the surface of the enclosing NvBlockSwCom- ponentType by means of the definition of attributes NvBlockDataMapping . bit- fieldTextTableMaskNvBlockDescriptor and NvBlockDataMapping . bit- fieldTextTableMaskPortPrototype . 3 The alternative to this approach would have been to shift this "distillation process" into the connec- tion between e.g. an ApplicationSwComponentType and an NvBlockSwComponentType . Such an approach comes with considerably heavier side effects and complexity (usage in Dele- gationSwConnector s or as part of a network connection) and is therefore not supported. 711 of 1113 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R20-11 In this case [constr_2013] is not applicable.

In this case [constr_2013] is not applicable.
